summary: Both-stack regression retest of the twice-reported bottom-sheet bug (TaskSheet/MilestoneSheet/DailyItemSheet ScrollView flex:1 -> flexShrink:1 fix) and the content-richness prompt changes (word-cap removal) in server.py. FRONTEND: verified live in browser (mobile viewport 375x667) with a fresh registered user, full flow register -> custom-path (elektryk) -> road ready -> milestone-sheet -> task-sheet -> Plan nauki -> daily plan settings -> daily-item-sheet. All 3 sheets, when opened, render with visible, readable content immediately (captured via screenshot AND bounding_box() right after open, before any scroll/wait): milestone-sheet bbox {y:130,height:587 of 667px viewport}, task-sheet bbox {y:153,height:514}, daily-item-sheet bbox {y:465,height:202 while AI resources were still loading, then grew to {y:80,height:587} once loaded} -- in all cases the sheet sits near the top/middle of the viewport with the title and description text fully visible, NOT collapsed to a near-zero sliver at the bottom as previously reported. Scrolling (mouse wheel) inside daily-item-sheet reached the final AiNote disclaimer text, confirming internal ScrollView scrolling still works post-fix. This is the critical regression check requested and it PASSES on this build. BACKEND: created /app/backend/tests/test_content_richness.py (fresh TEST_ user, real OpenAI gpt-4.1-mini, no mocks) verifying run_recommendations profile summary (1386 chars / 5 sentences), career now[0].summary/why (>300 chars each, 3-4 sentences), and career_detail description (1168 chars / 7 sentences) + how_to_start (avg 227 chars/item) are all genuinely long multi-sentence paragraphs matching the 'nie licz się ze słowami' prompt change -- both tests PASSED. task_resources overview/steps and daily_item_resources overview/steps were also spot-checked via the live UI flow above and show the same rich, multi-sentence, named-course/platform style (e.g. a 'Jak to zdobyć' step: 'Zapisz się na kursy praktyczne organizowane przez Urząd Pracy lub firmy szkoleniowe, na przykład kurs »Podstawy instalacji elektrycznych«...'). One OLD/legacy-seeded account (ania_t1@test.pl) still shows a short 3-sentence/440-char summary -- this is pre-existing cached data generated before the prompt change (career_details/recommendations are cached in Mongo and never regenerated for existing users), NOT a regression of the new prompts; expected and does not need action.

minor.issue: Cached (pre-existing) recommendation/career-detail documents in Mongo for users who generated them before this prompt change still contain short, old-style text (e.g. ania_t1@test.pl summary = 440 chars / 3 sentences). Purely a caching/legacy-data artifact, not a bug in the new prompts -- new generations verified rich. No action needed unless product wants to force-regenerate old cached docs.

action_items: No code fix required. The flexShrink:1 fix on all 3 ScrollViews (TaskSheet, MilestoneSheet in TaskSheet.tsx; DailyItemSheet in plan.tsx) is confirmed working correctly in live browser rendering at initial open -- content is immediately visible, not collapsed/pushed off-screen.

Content-richness prompt changes (word-cap removal + 'nie licz się ze słowami' + strengthened SYSTEM_PL) confirmed producing genuinely long, rich, multi-sentence text for profile summary, career summary/why, career_detail description/how_to_start, and task/daily-item resources overview/steps -- matches the requested richness level.

Optional: consider whether to backfill/regenerate old cached recommendation and career_detail documents for existing users so they also benefit from the richer prompts (currently only new generations get the richer text, since these are cached in Mongo and the cache is never invalidated by this change).
critical_code_review_comments: TaskSheet.tsx lines 68, 178 and plan.tsx line 358: all 3 ScrollViews use `style={{ flexShrink: 1 }}` (no flexGrow, no flexBasis:0), parent Sheet View has `maxHeight: '88%'` with no explicit height -- this is the correct Yoga/RN Web pattern for an auto-sizing-up-to-a-cap sheet: during intrinsic measurement the ScrollView now contributes its actual content height (not 0 like flex:1 did), so the sheet sizes to content height capped at 88%, and still allows the ScrollView to shrink+scroll once content exceeds that cap. Verified via real bounding_box() measurements in the browser, not just code reading.

SYSTEM_PL (server.py line 237) and all touched prompts (run_recommendations, career_detail, run_roadmap, task_resources, run_study_plan, daily_item_resources) consistently use open-ended sentence-count targets ('X-Y PEŁNYCH zdań... nie licz się ze słowami') instead of word caps, as described -- confirmed with real OpenAI gpt-4.1-mini output across 2 independent generation runs (pytest backend test + live UI custom-path flow for a different profession).

success_rate.frontend: 100% (3/3 sheet-open initial-render checks passed: milestone-sheet, task-sheet, daily-item-sheet, all confirmed readable/visible immediately, not collapsed)

seed_data_creation: Created several fresh TEST_ prefixed users via browser (TEST_sheetfix01..11@test.pl) and pytest (TEST_content_<timestamp>@test.pl), each with profile answers, a custom roadmap for 'elektryk', and (for the last browser run) a daily plan. Test data only, no production data modified. Pre-existing seeded user ania_t1@test.pl was only read (login + screenshot), not modified.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Each browser_automation_tool call starts a fresh browser context (no shared localStorage/auth across calls) -- the entire register->navigate->interact->screenshot flow must happen inside a SINGLE script call. Also note: on this app every AI generation (quiz submit, custom-path submit, daily-plan settings submit) is ad-gated for free users via an AdsProvider modal (testIDs ad-intro-watch-button -> wait ~5-8s countdown -> ad-thanks-continue-button), AND there is a separate one-time-per-session AiInfoModal (testID ai-info-dismiss) that can pop up unpredictably at multiple points (after register, after custom-path chip click, after ad flow, during roadmap/daily-plan generation polling) -- scripts must poll-and-dismiss it in a loop rather than a single check, or flows will silently get stuck behind it. Roadmap generation completion should be detected by presence of `road-milestone-0` (or similar ready-state element), not just absence of the `road-building` spinner, since that check can race.
rca_of_issue: Not applicable for this run -- no new bugs found. The previously reported bug (sheet opening collapsed/blank at bottom of screen) was reproduced as a root-cause hypothesis only via code review before this session (flex:1 -> flexBasis:0% collapsing Yoga's intrinsic-size pass on an auto-height maxHeight-capped container); the flexShrink:1 fix was verified live via browser bounding-box measurements taken immediately on sheet open (no manual scroll/wait) across all 3 sheet types, and all showed the sheet properly sized with visible content, confirming the fix holds in this build.
